text: The plan requires recording an immutable model version for AC8/AC9, but the existing ModelClient/OpenAI-compatible client exposes only modelName (the configured alias) and returns only content. No implementation step adds a version source, captures the API response model identifier, or rejects mutable aliases; therefore the proposed evidence cannot establish the required immutable model version or admissible same-configuration comparisons.
rationale: Real defect: the flagged lines changed in d22378a, the next commit. Ronda v0.2.0 posted no matching finding on this head. Plan PR counted in scope: Ronda reviews plan PRs and reports no findings. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
